visual.title: All positive leaves make P(+)
visual.caption: The two positive leaves are disjoint and together contain every positive test. Adding their joint probabilities gives P(+), the denominator that the posterior needs.

predict.question: How is P(+) built from the tree?
predict.explain: Total probability adds the joint probability of each disjoint path. The disease-positive leaf is 0.0095 and the healthy-positive leaf is 0.099, so P(+) = 0.1085.

label: The denominator of Bayes
